# Paths below are relative to docs/ai/tanstack-table/

# TanStack Table docs

> Supercharge your tables or build a datagrid from scratch in any framework while retaining 100% control over markup and styles.

- [Docs index](docs/index.md): This same Markdown index.
- [LLMs index](llms.txt): This same Markdown index.
- [Library home](https://tanstack.com/table/latest)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/tanstack/table)
- Packages: @tanstack/table-core, react-table.
- Frameworks: Angular, Ember, React, Preact, Solid, Svelte, Vue, Qwik, Lit, Alpine, Vanilla.

Use this index as the routing layer for the docs. Open one linked **local** Markdown page at a time (paths are relative to this folder). Prefer framework-specific pages when the user names a framework. Do not fetch the network.
